verses.text: For the music director. A psalm by David. LORD, I take refuge in you. Never let me be put to shame. Rescue me in your righteousness.
Lean down and listen to me. Rescue me quickly. Be my solid rock, a fortress where I can be safe.
You are my rock and my fortress. For the sake of your name, lead me and guide me.
Pull me out of the net they’ve hidden for me, because you’re my stronghold.
I place my spirit in your hands. You redeem me, LORD, God of truth.
I hate those who cling to worthless idols, but I trust in the LORD.
I’ll rejoice in your faithful love, because you’ve seen my suffering and known me through my troubles.
You haven’t handed me over to the enemy. You’ve set my feet in a wide-open place.
Have mercy on me, LORD, because I’m in distress. My eyes, my soul, and my body are wearing away with grief.
My life drains away in sorrow and my years in sighing. My guilt saps my strength, and my bones waste away.
Because of my enemies, my neighbors look down on me and people I know are horrified by me. When they see me on the street, they run away.
They’ve forgotten me as if I were dead. I’m like a broken pot.
I hear people slandering me. Terror is all around. They conspire together and plot to take my life.
But I trust you, LORD. I say, “You’re my God.”
My times are in your hands. Rescue me from my enemies and from those who pursue me.
Let your face shine on your servant. Save me in your faithful love.
LORD, I’ve called on you. Keep me from shame. Let the wicked be put to shame and go silent in Sheol.
Silence those lying lips that speak against the righteous with pride and contempt.
How great is the goodness you’ve stored up for those who fear you, the goodness you show in front of everyone to those who take refuge in you!
You hide them in the shelter of your presence from people’s schemes. You keep them safe in your dwelling, away from quarrels and accusations.
Praise the LORD! He showed me his wonderful faithful love in a fortified city.
I panicked and said, “I’ve been cut off from your sight.” Yet when I cried to you for help, you heard my plea.
Love the LORD, all you who are faithful to him! The LORD protects the faithful and pays the arrogant back in full.
Be strong and take heart, all you who put your hope in the LORD.
